column1: # Natural sincere negatives (round 4) — original sentences, not from any attack.
# Purpose: verify the tightened joke rules do not fire on ordinary sincere
# prose. Format: id \t claim \t evidence \t oracle(=NONJOKE).

column2: I do not hate the rain, but I love the extra time to read indoors.
We cannot approve the request today, but we can review it tomorrow.
The meeting is not at noon; it starts at one in the afternoon.
I never skip breakfast because I need the energy for work.
She does not enjoy the commute, but she does finish her podcasts.
If it stops raining, we will stop watering the garden.
I stopped seeing that dentist because I needed to stop driving so far.
The coach warned the team not to jump to conclusions before the rematch.
After the accident they needed time to get over it.
I am sick to death of these printer errors.
She told me a million times to lock the door.
I literally just finished the report.
The press conference starts at noon; the mayor will speak first.
The outage is ongoing; technicians are working on a fix.
System maintenance is scheduled for Sunday at midnight.
What time does the store close on Sundays?
Do you know why the bus is late today?
The package arrives tomorrow; tracking shows it left the facility.
I have no idea where I left my keys.
To save money, we switched to store-brand coffee.
Ice melts faster when the temperature rises above freezing.
The recipe calls for two cups of flour and one of sugar.
She whispered the answer because the baby was sleeping.
The doctor said to rest and drink plenty of fluids.
Iron the uniform before the inspection; wrinkles look sloppy.
The new policy takes effect on Monday morning.
He asked whether the meeting was still on for Thursday.
The flight is delayed; the next update comes at six.
I do not remember the password, but I wrote it down somewhere.
They moved the deadline to Friday to give everyone more time.
